tasks.name: Solve Planning Problem
tasks.description: Select a sequence of actions (a plan) to transition from an initial state to a desired goal state, often involving multiple subgoals and potential conflicts.

tasks.name: Execute Plan Step
tasks.description: Abstract task for executing a single primitive operation from a plan. Concrete domain tasks (e.g., 'Execute Painting Plan Step', 'Execute Block Move') specialize this task by listing their domain-specific operations in means.

tasks.name: Execute Painting Plan Step
tasks.description: Specialization of Execute Plan Step for the robot painting domain.

tasks.name: Execute Block Move
tasks.description: Specialization of Execute Plan Step for the Block World domain.

tasks.name: Paint ladder and ceiling
tasks.description: Creates a plan to solve the robot painting problem using partial order planning by creating plans to achieve the subgoal of painting the ceiling and subgoal of painting the ladder and then reordering the plans so that neither plan clobbers the goal of the other one.
tasks.given: valid(initialConfiguration) && valid(goalConfiguration) && initialConfiguration == (On(Robot, Floor) ^ Dry(Ladder) ^ Dry(Ceiling)) && goalConfiguration == (Painted(Ladder) ^ Painted(Ceiling))

tasks.name: Solve Block World problem
tasks.description: Creates a plan to solve the Block World problem using partial order planning.

tasks.name: GenerateSubgoalPlans
tasks.description: For each subgoal in the goal configuration, generate an independent partial plan that achieves it. This is a task because it reasons over multiple subgoals and produces multiple partial plans, not a single world-state transition.

tasks.name: Reorder Subgoal Plans
tasks.description: Given a conflict report, add ordering constraints to the partial plans to resolve all identified goal-clobbering conflicts. This is a task because it reasons across multiple partial plans and produces a revised multi-plan structure, not a single world-state transition.

tasks.name: SuccessGoal
tasks.description: Terminal task representing successful completion of a planning process.

tasks.name: FailureGoal
tasks.description: Terminal task representing failure of a planning process due to an unresolvable conflict or invalid state.
